narrative:
The workforce plan covers about 34,000 people — caseworkers and back-office processors 9,500, contact centre and citizen advisors 9,000, India delivery centres 6,000, pensions administrators and consultants 4,200, defence trainers and recruiters 2,300, group functions 1,800 and technology, data and AI 1,200. Total people cost is about GBP 1.0B.

On the 2,000-FTE, 29-contract contact-centre estate, the 15-minute forecast needs 1,946 FTE against 2,000 scheduled — a surplus overall but a 22-FTE gap on DWP Monday mornings. Each point of virtual-agent containment frees about 18 FTE on that estate.

Advisor attrition of 34% a year is the biggest cost lever after containment.
